# sbthemes.com

> **sbthemes.com** is a premium template marketplace offering high-performance website templates, UI kits, and design systems crafted with modern frontend technologies. Our templates help developers, designers, startups, and agencies build fast, beautiful, and responsive websites with ease.

## 🧩 What We Offer

sbthemes provides a wide collection of **free and premium templates** built using **Next.js, React, Nuxt, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, AngularJS, and HTML5**. These include:

- Landing Pages
- Admin Dashboards
- eCommerce Stores
- SaaS Product Sites
- Portfolios
- Business & Marketing Pages
- Educational Platforms
- Healthcare Sites
- Blog Layouts
- Authentication & Error Pages

All templates are **SEO-optimized**, **mobile-first**, and **developer-friendly** with clean, production-ready code. Our **All-Access Membership** includes every template, lifetime updates, commercial licenses, and priority support with faster response times.

## 🎯 Who It's For

Our templates are ideal for:

- Freelancers & Indie Hackers
- SaaS Founders & Product Teams
- Creative Agencies
- UI/UX Designers
- Developers building client projects
- Anyone launching fast with quality design
